subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `agents.defaults.iterationBudget` and per-agent overrides with the proposed 90/50 defaults, forced final summary, and `onBeforeToolCallingRound`/`supportsIterationBudget` harness contract?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish that the implementation works, but they cannot decide whether these user-facing defaults and plugin compatibility requirements should become long-term product contracts.

options.title: Approve current contract
options.body: Adopt the opt-in configuration, proposed defaults, final summary, and fail-closed harness negotiation after the lint fix and direct Codex verification.

options.title: Keep enforcement built-in only
options.body: Retain OpenClaw and Codex enforcement but remove or defer the general plugin-facing capability and unsupported-harness failure path.

options.title: Pause pending unified design
options.body: Hold or close the PR until maintainers define one resource-budget model spanning rounds, individual tool calls, channels, and timeouts.

recommendation.title: Approve current contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the opt-in configuration, proposed defaults, final summary, and fail-closed harness negotiation after the lint fix and direct Codex verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have the freshest implementation and proof context across the exact OpenClaw and Codex paths affected by this decision.
